WhatsApp Business catalogue kaise banaen

5 steps mein catalog banaiye.

1. Android: Menu (⋮) > Business tools > Catalogue. iPhone: Settings > Business tools > Catalogue.
2. + dabaiye, Add new item. 10 tak photos.
3. Naam aur price daaliye.
4. Description, link, item code. Save.
5. Chat mein 📎 > Catalog > Send.

Save kar lijiye, aaj raat dukaan band karke bana lijiye. Jis dost ki dukaan hai, use bhejiye 👇
